notes: Last Action Hero 1.12: walk from attract into the audits and backwards into the adjustments with fixed Black presses, then press Start on the printer adjustment shown; the printer data port (PIA2 port B, published at public solenoids 37-44 by the S11_PRINTERLINE flag) is watched for the ROM's writes. Each step's DMD frame is read afterwards.

actions.label: Black press 1 with the Green input low (FORWARD), toward the audits
Black press 2 with the Green input low (FORWARD), toward the audits
Black press 3 with the Green input low (FORWARD), toward the audits
hold the Green input high (REVERSE) so Black steps backwards
reverse Black press 1, stepping backwards from the audits into the adjustments
reverse Black press 2, stepping backwards from the audits into the adjustments
reverse Black press 3, stepping backwards from the audits into the adjustments
reverse Black press 4, stepping backwards from the audits into the adjustments
press Start on the adjustment shown
